scenes.text: Imagine standing right next to a beautiful, glass-like lake in Tanzania, only to realize that the highly toxic water actually turns unsuspecting birds and bats into solid stone statues.
This deadly crimson oasis is called Lake Natron, and its extreme alkaline water, filled with volcanic chemicals, creates a corrosive environment that reaches a skin-burning pH level of twelve.

When animals crash into the lake's deceptive, mirror-like surface, they instantly drown, and the heavy mineral mixture perfectly calcifies their bodies, leaving behind bone-dry mummies frozen in time forever.

If you personally stumbled upon these eerie, frozen creatures scattered on the dry shoreline, would you ever be brave enough to touch them, or would you run away? Make sure to follow and comment your thoughts down below!
